metadata.title: Flow Matching for Generative Modeling
metadata.authors: Yaron Lipman, Ricky T. Q. Chen, Heli Ben-Hamu, Maximilian Nickel, Matt Le

nodes.name: Probability density path
nodes.statement: A probability density path is a time-dependent probability density function $p:[0,1]\times \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}_{>0}$, satisfying $\int p_t(x)\,dx = 1$ for each $t$.
nodes.statement_clean: A time-dependent probability density on R^d.

nodes.name: Time-dependent vector field
nodes.statement: A time-dependent vector field is a map $v:[0,1]\times \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}^d$, written $v_t(x)$.

nodes.name: Flow
nodes.statement: A flow is a time-dependent diffeomorphic map $\phi:[0,1]\times \mathbb{R}^d \to \mathbb{R}^d$ defined by the ODE $\frac{d}{dt}\phi_t(x) = v_t(\phi_t(x))$ with $\phi_0(x)=x$.

nodes.name: Continuous Normalizing Flow (CNF)
nodes.statement: A CNF is a flow $\phi_t$ generated by a neural-network vector field $v_t(x;\theta)$, used to push a simple prior density $p_0$ to a target $p_1$ via $p_t = [\phi_t]_* p_0$.

nodes.name: Push-forward equation
nodes.statement: The push-forward of $p_0$ by $\phi_t$ is $[\phi_t]_* p_0(x) = p_0(\phi_t^{-1}(x))\,\det\!\big[\partial \phi_t^{-1}/\partial x\,(x)\big]$.

nodes.name: Vector field generates a probability path
nodes.statement: A vector field $v_t$ generates a probability density path $p_t$ if its flow $\phi_t$ satisfies $p_t = [\phi_t]_* p_0$.

nodes.name: Conditional probability path
nodes.statement: Given a data sample $x_1$, $p_t(x|x_1)$ is a conditional probability path with $p_0(x|x_1)=p(x)$ and $p_1(x|x_1)$ concentrated near $x_1$, e.g.\ $\mathcal{N}(x|x_1,\sigma^2 I)$ for small $\sigma>0$.

nodes.name: Marginal probability path
nodes.statement: $p_t(x) = \int p_t(x|x_1)\,q(x_1)\,dx_1$, the mixture of conditional paths over the data distribution $q$.

nodes.name: Marginal vector field
nodes.statement: $u_t(x) = \int u_t(x|x_1)\,\frac{p_t(x|x_1)\,q(x_1)}{p_t(x)}\,dx_1$, where $u_t(\cdot|x_1)$ generates the conditional path $p_t(\cdot|x_1)$.

nodes.name: Gaussian conditional probability path
nodes.statement: $p_t(x|x_1) = \mathcal{N}(x\,|\,\mu_t(x_1),\,\sigma_t(x_1)^2 I)$, with boundary conditions $\mu_0(x_1)=0,\sigma_0(x_1)=1$ and $\mu_1(x_1)=x_1,\sigma_1(x_1)=\sigma_{\min}$.

nodes.name: Conditional Gaussian flow $\psi_t$
nodes.statement: $\psi_t(x) = \sigma_t(x_1)\,x + \mu_t(x_1)$, the affine map that pushes the standard Gaussian to $p_t(x|x_1)$.

nodes.name: Optimal Transport displacement interpolant
nodes.statement: $p_t = [(1-t)\,\mathrm{id} + t\,\psi]_* p_0$, where $\psi$ is the OT map from $p_0$ to $p_1$.

nodes.name: Continuity equation
nodes.statement: $\frac{d}{dt}p_t(x) + \mathrm{div}\,(p_t(x)\,v_t(x)) = 0$; necessary and sufficient PDE for $v_t$ to generate $p_t$.

nodes.name: Flow Matching objective
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{t,p_t(x)}\,\|v_t(x) - u_t(x)\|^2$, with $t\sim\mathcal{U}[0,1]$, $x\sim p_t(x)$.

nodes.name: Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) objective
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CFM}}(\theta) = \mathbb{E}_{t,q(x_1),p_t(x|x_1)}\,\|v_t(x) - u_t(x|x_1)\|^2$.

nodes.name: VE conditional vector field
nodes.statement: For the reversed Variance-Exploding path $p_t(x)=\mathcal{N}(x|x_1,\sigma_{1-t}^2 I)$: $u_t(x|x_1) = -\frac{\sigma'_{1-t}}{\sigma_{1-t}}(x-x_1)$.

nodes.name: VP conditional vector field
nodes.statement: For the reversed Variance-Preserving path $p_t(x|x_1)=\mathcal{N}(x\,|\,\alpha_{1-t}x_1,(1-\alpha_{1-t}^2)I)$ with $\alpha_t=e^{-T(t)/2}$: $u_t(x|x_1)=\frac{\alpha'_{1-t}}{1-\alpha_{1-t}^2}\,(\alpha_{1-t}x-x_1)$.

nodes.name: OT conditional vector field
nodes.statement: Setting $\mu_t(x)=tx_1,\ \sigma_t(x)=1-(1-\sigma_{\min})t$ gives $u_t(x|x_1)=\frac{x_1-(1-\sigma_{\min})x}{1-(1-\sigma_{\min})t}$ and conditional flow $\psi_t(x)=(1-(1-\sigma_{\min})t)x+tx_1$.

nodes.name: CFM loss for OT path
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CFM}}(\theta)=\mathbb{E}_{t,q(x_1),p(x_0)}\,\big\|v_t(\psi_t(x_0)) - (x_1-(1-\sigma_{\min})x_0)\big\|^2$.

nodes.name: Marginal vector field generates marginal probability path
nodes.statement: Given vector fields $u_t(x|x_1)$ that generate conditional paths $p_t(x|x_1)$, for any $q(x_1)$ the marginal vector field $u_t$ in (eq.\ marginal) generates the marginal path $p_t$, i.e.\ $u_t,p_t$ satisfy the continuity equation.
assumptions: $u_t(x|x_1)$ generates the conditional path $p_t(x|x_1)$ for each $x_1$
Regularity allowing exchange of integration and differentiation (Leibniz rule)

nodes.name: Equivalence of FM and CFM gradients
nodes.statement: Assuming $p_t(x)>0$ for all $x\in\mathbb{R}^d$ and $t\in[0,1]$, $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CFM}}$ and $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}$ differ by a constant in $\theta$; hence $\nabla_\theta\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}(\theta)=\nabla_\theta\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CFM}}(\theta)$.

nodes.name: Conditional vector field for Gaussian path
nodes.statement: Let $p_t(x|x_1)=\mathcal{N}(x|\mu_t(x_1),\sigma_t(x_1)^2 I)$ with conditional flow $\psi_t(x)=\sigma_t(x_1)x+\mu_t(x_1)$. The unique vector field defining $\psi_t$ is $u_t(x|x_1)=\frac{\sigma'_t(x_1)}{\sigma_t(x_1)}(x-\mu_t(x_1))+\mu'_t(x_1)$, and it generates $p_t(x|x_1)$.
assumptions: $p_t(x|x_1)=\mathcal{N}(x|\mu_t(x_1),\sigma_t(x_1)^2 I)$ is a Gaussian conditional path

nodes.name: Time-reversal of vector fields
nodes.statement: If $u_t$ generates $p_t$, then $\tilde{u}_t(x)=-u_{1-t}(x)$ generates $\tilde{p}_t(x)=p_{1-t}(x)$ (with $\tilde{p}_0=p_1$).

nodes.name: Diffusion-Mixture Representation Theorem
nodes.statement: Provides a formula for the marginal drift and diffusion coefficients in diffusion SDEs as a mixture over conditional drifts; used as an alternative derivation of Theorem \ref{thm:marginal_vf}.

nodes.name: Gaussian OT displacement map (Example 1.7, McCann 1997)
nodes.statement: For two Gaussians where the first is standard, the optimal-transport displacement map between them is affine and equals $\psi_t(x)=(1-(1-\sigma_{\min})t)x+tx_1$.

nodes.name: Instantaneous change of variables
nodes.statement: $\frac{d}{dt}\log p_t(\phi_t(x)) + \mathrm{div}\,v_t(\phi_t(x)) = 0$, integrating to $\log p_1(\phi_1(x))-\log p_0(\phi_0(x))=-\int_0^1 \mathrm{div}\,v_t(\phi_t(x))\,dt$.
nodes.origin_citation: Chen et al. 2018; Ben-Hamu et al. 2022

nodes.name: Score Matching loss
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{SM}}(\theta)=\mathbb{E}_{t,q(x_1),p_t(x|x_1)}\,\lambda(t)\big\|s_t(x)-\frac{x-\mu_t(x_1)}{\sigma_t^2(x_1)}\big\|^2$.

nodes.name: DDPM (noise matching) loss
nodes.statement: $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{NM}}(\theta)=\mathbb{E}_{t,q(x_1),p_0(x_0)}\,\big\|\epsilon_t(\sigma_t(x_1)x_0+\mu_t(x_1))-x_0\big\|^2$.

nodes.name: Conditional Flow Matching training (FM)
nodes.statement: Train a CNF $v_t(x;\theta)$ by minimizing the per-sample regression loss $\|v_t(x)-u_t(x|x_1)\|^2$ with $t\sim\mathcal{U}[0,1]$, $x_1\sim q$, $x\sim p_t(x|x_1)$.
input: Choice of conditional Gaussian path: $\mu_t(x_1),\sigma_t(x_1)$ (e.g. VP-Diffusion or OT)
Initial parameters $\theta$ for neural vector field $v_t(x;\theta)$
output: Trained vector field $v_t(x;\theta^*)$ approximating the marginal $u_t$
Generative CNF that pushes $p_0=\mathcal{N}(0,I)$ to $p_1\approx q$

nodes.name: CNF likelihood / sample-density evaluation via reverse ODE
nodes.statement: Compute $\log p_1(x_1)$ by reverse-time integration of the joint ODE $(\phi,f)$ from $t=1$ to $t=0$ with $f(1)=0$, then $\log p_1(x_1)=\log p_0(\phi_0(x_1))-f(0)$.
output: $\log p_1(x_1)$ (or unbiased estimate via Hutchinson trace estimator)

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 1 (marginal VF generates marginal path)
nodes.statement: Direct verification of the continuity equation for $(p_t,u_t)$ using Leibniz rule and the fact that each $u_t(\cdot|x_1)$ generates $p_t(\cdot|x_1)$.

nodes.name: Differentiate marginal under the integral
nodes.statement: Apply Leibniz rule to swap $\frac{d}{dt}$ and $\int dx_1$: $\frac{d}{dt}p_t(x)=\int \frac{d}{dt}p_t(x|x_1)\,q(x_1)\,dx_1$.

nodes.name: Apply conditional continuity equation
nodes.statement: Use that $u_t(\cdot|x_1)$ generates $p_t(\cdot|x_1)$ to substitute $\frac{d}{dt}p_t(x|x_1)=-\mathrm{div}(u_t(x|x_1)p_t(x|x_1))$.

nodes.name: Pull divergence outside the integral
nodes.statement: Swap $\mathrm{div}$ with $\int dx_1$ to obtain $-\mathrm{div}\big(\int u_t(x|x_1)p_t(x|x_1)q(x_1)\,dx_1\big)$.

nodes.name: Recognize marginal vector field and conclude
nodes.statement: Use the definition of $u_t$ in (eq.\ marginal-VF) to rewrite the integrand as $u_t(x)\,p_t(x)$, giving $\frac{d}{dt}p_t(x)=-\mathrm{div}(u_t(x)p_t(x))$ — the continuity equation.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 2 (FM and CFM gradients are equal)
nodes.statement: Expand the squared norms, use bilinearity of the inner product, swap order of integration via Fubini to identify $\mathbb{E}_{p_t(x)}\langle v_t,u_t\rangle$ with $\mathbb{E}_{q(x_1),p_t(x|x_1)}\langle v_t,u_t(\cdot|x_1)\rangle$.

nodes.name: Expand both squared norms
nodes.statement: $\|v_t-u_t\|^2 = \|v_t\|^2 - 2\langle v_t,u_t\rangle + \|u_t\|^2$, similarly for $\|v_t-u_t(\cdot|x_1)\|^2$.

nodes.name: Match $\|v_t\|^2$ terms across the two losses
nodes.statement: Using $p_t(x)=\int p_t(x|x_1)q(x_1)dx_1$, $\mathbb{E}_{p_t(x)}\|v_t\|^2=\mathbb{E}_{q(x_1),p_t(x|x_1)}\|v_t\|^2$.

nodes.name: Match cross terms via the marginal VF formula
nodes.statement: Substitute the definition of $u_t(x)$ into $\mathbb{E}_{p_t(x)}\langle v_t,u_t\rangle$ and change order of integration to obtain $\mathbb{E}_{q(x_1),p_t(x|x_1)}\langle v_t,u_t(\cdot|x_1)\rangle$.

nodes.name: Conclude losses differ by a $\theta$-independent constant
nodes.statement: The remaining $\|u_t\|^2$ and $\|u_t(\cdot|x_1)\|^2$ terms are independent of $\theta$, hence $\nabla_\theta\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{FM}}=\nabla_\theta\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{CFM}}$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem 3 (Gaussian conditional VF)
nodes.statement: Substitute $\psi_t^{-1}(y)=(y-\mu_t)/\sigma_t$ and $\psi'_t(x)=\sigma'_t x + \mu'_t$ into $\psi'_t(\psi_t^{-1}(y))=u_t(y|x_1)$ to recover the closed-form $u_t$.

nodes.name: Set up ODE on $\psi_t$
nodes.statement: Write the ODE $\frac{d}{dt}\psi_t(x)=u_t(\psi_t(x)|x_1)$ and let $w_t(x)=u_t(x|x_1)$ for brevity.

nodes.name: Invert affine flow
nodes.statement: Since $\sigma_t(x_1)>0$, $\psi_t$ is invertible with $\psi_t^{-1}(y)=(y-\mu_t(x_1))/\sigma_t(x_1)$.

nodes.name: Substitute and conclude formula for $u_t(y|x_1)$
nodes.statement: Plug $x=\psi_t^{-1}(y)$ into $\psi'_t$ to get $w_t(y)=\frac{\sigma'_t(x_1)}{\sigma_t(x_1)}(y-\mu_t(x_1))+\mu'_t(x_1)$.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma (time-reversal)
nodes.statement: Apply the continuity equation to $\tilde{p}_t=p_{1-t}$ and substitute $\tilde{u}_t=-u_{1-t}$ to verify it satisfies the equation.

nodes.name: Variance-Exploding (VE) diffusion path
nodes.statement: Setting $\mu_t(x_1)=x_1,\ \sigma_t(x_1)=\sigma_{1-t}$ in Theorem 3 yields the VE conditional path and its VF $u_t(x|x_1)=-(\sigma'_{1-t}/\sigma_{1-t})(x-x_1)$.

nodes.name: Variance-Preserving (VP) diffusion path
nodes.statement: With $\mu_t(x_1)=\alpha_{1-t}x_1,\ \sigma_t(x_1)=\sqrt{1-\alpha_{1-t}^2}$, Theorem 3 yields the VP conditional VF coinciding with Song et al.\ probability-flow ODE.

nodes.name: Optimal-Transport (OT) conditional path
nodes.statement: Linearly-changing mean and std $\mu_t(x)=tx_1,\ \sigma_t(x)=1-(1-\sigma_{\min})t$ give the OT displacement interpolant and a constant-direction VF.

nodes.name: 2D checkerboard density-modeling experiment
nodes.statement: Train CNFs on a 2D checkerboard target with SM/Diffusion, FM/Diffusion, and FM/OT; FM-OT introduces the checkerboard pattern earliest and yields lowest NFE for fixed-step solvers.

nodes.name: Unconditional ImageNet image generation (32, 64, 128)
nodes.statement: Apply FM-OT, FM-Diffusion, and SM-Diffusion baselines on CIFAR-10 and ImageNet 32/64/128. FM-OT achieves best NLL, FID, and NFE on every benchmark; ImageNet-128 NLL=2.90, FID=20.9.

nodes.name: Image super-resolution 64$\to$256 with conditional FM
nodes.statement: Use FM-OT for conditional upsampling on ImageNet validation set; achieves FID 3.4, IS 200.8, surpassing SR3 and regression baselines.

nodes.name: OT marginal flow is not itself an OT solution
nodes.statement: Although the conditional flow $\psi_t$ is the OT displacement map, the marginal vector field $u_t$ is generally NOT the OT solution between $p_0$ and $p_1$; it is only expected to remain relatively simple.

nodes.name: OT VF has constant direction in time
nodes.statement: The OT conditional VF factors as $u_t(x|x_1)=g(t)\,h(x|x_1)$, so its direction is constant in $t$, encouraging straight-line trajectories.

nodes.name: FM with diffusion path coincides with probability-flow ODE
nodes.statement: Restricted to VE and VP paths, the conditional VF $u_t$ from Theorem 3 coincides with the deterministic probability-flow ODE of Song et al.\ (2020), equation 13.

nodes.name: Simulation-free training of CNFs
nodes.statement: Given samples from an unknown data distribution $q(x_1)$, learn parameters $\theta$ of a neural vector field $v_t(x;\theta)$ such that the induced CNF flow pushes a simple prior $p_0$ to $p_1\approx q$ — without ODE simulation during training and with unbiased gradients.
